article_title: Dame Judi Dench joins call to keep Archers in Birmingham

tasks.prompt: What is the article mainly about?
options: More than 100 people connected with The Archers are urging the BBC to keep recording the programme in Birmingham.
The BBC has cancelled The Archers after its 75th anniversary.
Dame Judi Dench has been chosen to build a new studio in Digbeth.
The fictional village of Ambridge is being moved to London.
tasks.correct_answer: More than 100 people connected with The Archers are urging the BBC to keep recording the programme in Birmingham.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה עוסקת בקמפיין של יותר מ־100 אנשי צוות ושחקנים, ובהם ג׳ודי דנץ׳, להשאיר את הקלטת התוכנית בבירמינגהם.

tasks.prompt: What BBC decision led to the campaign?
options: It decided to shorten every episode.
It sold the fictional village of Ambridge.
It shelved plans for a dedicated studio at its new Digbeth headquarters.
It removed all West Midlands actors from the cast.
tasks.correct_answer: It shelved plans for a dedicated studio at its new Digbeth headquarters.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הקמפיין החל לאחר שה־BBC גנז את התוכנית להקים אולפן ייעודי במטה החדש בדיגבת׳.

tasks.prompt: What does “shelve plans” mean in the article?
options: Display the plans in a library
Postpone or abandon the plans
Complete the plans ahead of schedule
Move the plans to a television archive
tasks.explanation_hebrew: shelve plans פירושו להניח תוכניות בצד, כלומר לדחות אותן או להפסיק לקדם אותן.

tasks.prompt: How long has The Archers always been recorded in Birmingham?
options: Since it began, and it celebrated its 75th anniversary this year
Only since the new Digbeth headquarters opened
For the past ten years
Since Dame Judi Dench joined the programme
tasks.correct_answer: Since it began, and it celebrated its 75th anniversary this year
tasks.explanation_hebrew: לפי הכתבה, התוכנית הוקלטה תמיד בבירמינגהם מאז תחילתה וחגגה השנה 75 שנים.

tasks.prompt: Why do supporters compare moving The Archers to moving Coronation Street or EastEnders away from their regions?
options: To argue that regional identity is an important part of each programme
To suggest that all three programmes use the same actors
To prove that Birmingham has the cheapest studios in Britain
To request that the programmes exchange their fictional locations
tasks.correct_answer: To argue that regional identity is an important part of each programme
tasks.explanation_hebrew: ההשוואה מדגישה שהקשר לאזור הוא חלק מהותי מזהות התוכנית, ולכן העברתה עלולה לפגוע באופייה.

tasks.prompt: What does “a tangible impact” mean in the supporters' letter?
options: An effect that is real and noticeable
A change that exists only in fiction
A benefit measured only by audience age
A temporary pause with no consequences
tasks.correct_answer: An effect that is real and noticeable
tasks.explanation_hebrew: tangible impact הוא השפעה ממשית ומורגשת; החותמים חוששים שהמעבר ישפיע בפועל על אופן יצירת התוכנית.

tasks.prompt: Who signed or supported the call to keep The Archers in Birmingham?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין יותר מ־100 אנשי צוות בעבר ובהווה, שמות בולטים, נציגי האיגודים, וראש עיריית וסט מידלנדס.
expected_points: More than 100 current and former cast and crew members signed the letter.
Named supporters include Dame Judi Dench, Felicity Jones and Kellie Bright.
Representatives of Equity and the Writers' Guild also signed.
West Midlands Mayor Richard Parker separately called for the programme to remain in Birmingham.

tasks.prompt: Summarise the arguments for keeping The Archers in Birmingham and the BBC's response.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציג את חשיבות בירמינגהם לזהות התוכנית, החשש מפיצול ההפקה ופגיעה באיכות, ומנגד את הצורך בחיסכון ואת בדיקת החלופות.
expected_points: Supporters say Birmingham has shaped the programme's identity throughout its 75-year history.
They warn that separating cast and production teams could harm quality and the show's future.
They argue a flagship programme deserves suitable facilities that would also benefit Birmingham.
The BBC says it must save money, remains committed to The Archers and is exploring studio options, including in the West Midlands.

tasks.prompt: Why might separating the cast and production teams change the way the programme sounds or feels?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר שעבודה משותפת תומכת בתיאום, ביצוע והפקת סאונד, ושהרחקה מהאזור שעליו התוכנית מבוססת עלולה להחליש את האותנטיות.
expected_points: Recording together can support coordination between actors, directors and sound engineers.
A shared production base can help maintain consistent performance and sound quality.
The West Midlands setting and local heritage contribute to the programme's identity.
Moving or splitting teams may weaken continuity and regional authenticity.

tasks.prompt: Write a short neutral briefing about the disagreement over The Archers' future recording location.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין את גניזת האולפן, טענות החותמים, נימוק החיסכון של ה־BBC, והעובדה שטרם התקבלה החלטה סופית על חלופה.
expected_points: State that the BBC shelved plans for a dedicated studio at its new Digbeth headquarters.
Explain that more than 100 cast and crew members want recording to stay in Birmingham.
Mention concerns about regional identity, quality and keeping production teams together.
Note that the BBC cites savings and is still examining alternative studios around the country and in the West Midlands.
